Topic Of Interest:
Build an n8n automation that reads some data from a Google Sheet, structures that data into a
clean email (a subject line and a readable message body), and sends it through Gmail to any
email address you choose. The workflow should pull the data, format it into an email, and deliver it
end to end without you writing the email by hand.
